Specialized required courses History Of Chinese Political Thoughts History Of Chinese Political System Foreign Government And Politics Of Political Science Comparative Political Science Analysis Of Rural Politics In China Foreign Secective Readings In Political Science Public Administration Theory 2.Period of Study After formal admission, students will have a full-time study for 4 years in China University of Political Science and Law (CUPL). 3. Tuition and Application Fee of the Preparatory Courses Tuition is 20,000 RMB per year; application fee is 660 RMB. Those whose Chinese proficiency is under HSK level 5,without receiving preparatory courses and intend to directly enter bachelor's degree studyneed to pay the application service fee 10,000 RMB (including the related costs used for: Chinese courses, major courses, guidance to studying abroad, selection of majors and completion of relevant procedures etc.). 4. Scholarship Foreign students will obtain "the scholarship for freshmen", once they are admitted by our university as freshmen. 5. Accommodations Students can live in the students’ apartments arranged by the School of International Education, or solve accommodations by themselves.
